question: Should empty QA Lab dashboard and API run requests intentionally migrate to the canonical `smoke-ci` profile and strict compatibility errors, replacing the prior dashboard-only live, fast, flow-only defaults?
rationale: The branch makes this user-visible compatibility decision deliberately, but the provided review context contains no explicit maintainer approval for changing existing operator and API request semantics.

options.title: Approve canonical defaults
options.body: Accept `smoke-ci` and fail-closed validation as the supported default contract, then merge with the updated operator documentation.

options.title: Preserve legacy empty requests
options.body: Keep the shared planner but map empty legacy dashboard/API requests to the prior effective behavior until a separately approved migration exists.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Land only the mixed-kind and visible-control fixes, deferring the empty-request default migration to a focused compatibility decision.
